heading: The Fiery Furnace Bible Crossword
description: Solve a fiery furnace Bible crossword: the golden image, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, and the fourth man in the fire. Free KJV puzzles on iOS.
prose: An image of gold on the plain of Dura, an orchestra to cue the bowing, and three men who will not. The Fiery Furnace covers Daniel 3 — the furnace heated seven times more than it was wont, the mighty men bound and cast in, and the king rising up in haste because he can count to four.
The three Hebrew names are the backbone of the grid, and they cross beautifully. The closing verse is the king's own description of the fourth figure walking in the fire.

clues.text: King who set up the golden image
One of the three, with Meshach and Abednego
How many times more the furnace was heated
The fourth in the fire was like the ___ of God

verseText: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
